parts.title: Writing Task 1
parts.passage:
The line graph below shows the number of people who visited three different art galleries in the city centre between 2000 and 2020.

[Imagine a line graph here with three lines representing three art galleries: 'Modern Art Gallery', 'Classical Sculpture Museum', 'Contemporary Photography Centre'. Y-axis: Number of visitors (thousands), X-axis: Years (2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020). The lines would show different trends like increase, decrease, or fluctuation.]

questions.instruction:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
Write at least 150 words.

parts.title: Writing Task 2
parts.passage: Some people believe that the increasing use of technology in education is creating a digital divide between rich and poor students. Others argue that technology provides unprecedented opportunities for learning for everyone.

questions.instruction:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
Write at least 250 words.
